layering_contract: One shared ABC/eCash optimization base preserves eCash consensus. Implement each generic optimization once; add minimal adapters and genuinely V2-specific mechanisms after the explicit V2 boundary. Historical V2 assumptions in shared code are backport defects, not authorized consensus changes.
patch_policy: One purposeful change, including its implementation, required declarations/build wiring and regressions. Fold later-discovered defects into their first responsible owner; preserve repair provenance separately.
source_identity_policy: canonical_* fields describe actual replay; null means not yet established. sha/tree/parent remain immutable split-stage provenance and are not repaired-source identities.
hash_boundary_contract: User policy: shared eCash cryptographic identifiers, including internal batch IDs, use SHA256/SHA256d. BLAKE3 vendor and any hash adaptation remain entirely after the V2 boundary. PoW, signature transcripts and commitment hashes are separate explicit decisions; no blanket substitution or tree-structure performance claim.
